_about: The feature register (David, 2026-10-13: the app and the documents drifted because nothing checked that every feature traces to a document). Every view, library module, route and worker route is listed with what forces it: a Core Purpose promise (P1...), a decision (D0001...), a tenet (T1...T7), or an invariant (INV). status: 'forced' needs at least one trace; 'support' is plumbing a forced feature runs on (name what); 'unforced' is carried with no document behind it and stays on the register as an open question for David until it is traced, parked or cut. tests/features.test.js fails the build on anything unregistered or on a trace that does not exist.
